missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics for reserve_inventory
Inventory service logs around the timeout window
candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in the inventory service, causing inventory reservation 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway checkout 502s across all sampled traces.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs confirm the underlying cause of the timeouts (saturation, network, or config).

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway checkout 502; metrics show 16 checkout 502s and p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Bounded to redis-timeout; underlying Redis cause unconfirmed.
